notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.content:
Update list: 

1. The main innovation was the improvement of artificial intelligence, now zombies will not just run at the player when you appear, and patrol the area and attack if the player enters the field of view. 
2. Altars have been added to the game, next to them you can find weapons. 
3. The speed of zombies has been significantly reduced, now you can run away from them, the number of health has been increased. 
4. Correction of detected bugs and errors. 
5. Turkish was added to the game. 

Your team Zombies In The Forest

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Before the release of our game are a few days!

Of course updates before release are intended primarily for polishing the finished product. And we have something to brag about:
1) After deep optimization, we managed to increase the level of performance on different configurations by 15-35%. In our opinion, this is an impressive result!
2) Various small bugs and defects that caused discomfort during the game were fixed.
3) Seriously improved physics and animation quality

Thank you to all who support us and follow our game, you are very important to us

Your team Zombies in The Forest
